# Zytrax

> Zytrax provides comprehensive technical guides and reference materials for DNS, LDAP, SSL/TLS, web technologies, and network protocols.

Zytrax is a technical knowledge resource offering in-depth 'Rocket Scientists' guides and survival guides for system administrators, network engineers, and web developers. The site covers both foundational networking concepts and practical implementation guides for open-source technologies.

## Key Topics

- DNS
- LDAP
- SSL/TLS
- Apache
- HTML5
- X.509 Certificates
- Kerberos
- Postfix
- Web Development
- Browser Detection
- Server-Side Includes
- CSS
- ASN.1
- Open Source
- Technical Reference

## Core Guides & Books

- [ZYTRAX Open Rocket Scientist Guides](http://zytrax.com/books): ZYTRAX open guides covering DNS, LDAP, SSL/TLS, and cryptography
- [DNS for Rocket Scientists - Contents](http://zytrax.com/books/dns): Comprehensive DNS guide table of contents for network professionals
- [Open Source Guide - LDAP for Rocket Scientists - Contents](http://zytrax.com/books/ldap): LDAP directory services guide covering open source implementation
- [ZYTRAX: Training and Knowledge Acquisition](http://zytrax.com/training): ZYTRAX training hub covering DNS, LDAP, security, and protocols

## Survival Guides

- [Tech Stuff - Survival Guides](http://zytrax.com/tech/survival): Survival guides for SSL/TLS, Kerberos, Postfix, and DNS/LDAP
- [Survival Guide - TLS/SSL and SSL (X.509) Certificates (CA-signed and Self-Signed)](http://zytrax.com/tech/survival/ssl.html): TLS/SSL and X.509 certificate guide covering handshake, formats, CA

## Web Technologies & Development

- [Tech Stuff](http://zytrax.com/tech): Main technology guides covering web, SSL/TLS, Apache, and protocols
- [Tech Stuff - Web](http://zytrax.com/tech/web): Web technology documentation for HTML5, Apache, and browser detection
- [Tech Stuff - HTML5 Conversion](http://zytrax.com/tech/css/html5.html): Guide to HTML5 conversion with CSS techniques and browser compatibility
- [Tech Stuff - CSS Techniques and Workarounds](http://zytrax.com/tech/css/workarounds.html): CSS techniques, workarounds, and cross-browser compatibility solutions
- [Tech Stuff - HTML Entities and Codings](http://zytrax.com/tech/web/entities.html): HTML entities and character encoding reference for web development

## Browser & Web Reference

- [Tech Stuff - Browser ID Strings (a.k.a. User Agent ID)](http://zytrax.com/tech/web/browser_ids.htm): Browser user agent string reference for web development
- [Mobile Browser ID Strings (a.k.a. User Agent ID)](http://zytrax.com/tech/web/mobile_ids.html): Mobile browser user agent string reference and identification guide
- [Tech Stuff - Server Side Browser Sniffing](http://zytrax.com/tech/web/browser_sniffing.html): Apache server-side browser detection and sniffing techniques

## Apache & Server Configuration

- [Tech Stuff - Apache Environmental Variables](http://zytrax.com/tech/web/env_var.htm): Apache environmental variables reference for server configuration
- [Tech Stuff - Apache Server Side Includes (SSI and XSSI)](http://zytrax.com/tech/web/ssi.htm): Apache SSI and XSSI configuration and usage guide

## Technical Reference

- [Tech Stuff - Hexadecimal, Decimal and Binary](http://zytrax.com/tech/protocols/hex.html): Number system conversion reference for hexadecimal, decimal, binary

## Support & Contact

- [ZyTrax Contacts](http://zytrax.com/Company/contacts.html): ZyTrax company contact information and details
- [Inquiry or Feedback Form](http://zytrax.com/feedback.htm): Contact form for submitting inquiries and feedback to Zytrax
